info.title: Golden Helix Admin Server API
info.description: Provides endpoints for server configuration, licensing, user/session management, runners and agents, server events, workspace activities, and user/workspace management.

post.summary: Set a store value
post.description: Set a store value for a given scope and key. The value can be a string or a base64 encoded string for binary mime types. If the mime type is application/json, the value will be parsed and re-serialized to ensure compactness. The global scope can have a public read permission (set by admin).

post.summary: Add a Docker image to the workspace list
post.description: Adds a Docker image to the workspace default-image vars under an auto-generated variable name, without pulling it. This is a workspace admin-only operation.

post.summary: Remove Docker images from the workspace list
post.description: Removes user-managed images from the workspace: the workspace default-image var(s) holding them (excluding platform-managed vars) plus any legacy pinned entries. Images referenced by tasks, plugins, applications, or a platform-managed var cannot be removed. This is a workspace admin-only operation.

get.summary: List all Docker images on the host
get.description: Every image visible to the server's Docker/Podman user, one row per repo tag, with the references that make it in use (workspace lists, existing containers, the server image). Images with no references are unused.

post.summary: Pull a Docker image to the host
post.description: Pulls an image on the server host without associating it with any workspace. With background=true the call returns immediately and the list endpoint reports pull progress.

get.summary: List unused Docker images
get.description: Dry run of purgeUnused: the images that would be removed and the bytes that would be reclaimed.

post.summary: Remove Docker images from the host
post.description: Removes images by repo tag (or image ID for dangling images). Images backing an existing container are refused.

post.summary: Remove all unused Docker images
post.description: Removes every image with no references (not in any workspace image list, not backing any container, and not the server image).

get.summary: Docker images needed by dynamic agents
get.description: Built dynamically: every workspace's image list plus the server image — everything an agent must carry to run any task on any workspace. Cloud provisioning uses this to build agent VM templates.
